dialogues.jp: ぐつぐつ。
dialogues.en: Bubble.
dialogues.text: Bubble.

dialogues.jp: ぐつぐつ。
dialogues.en: Bubble.
dialogues.text: Bubble.

dialogues.jp: 部屋中にカレーの匂いが充満する。
dialogues.en: The smell of curry fills the room.
dialogues.text: The smell of curry fills the room.

dialogues.jp: 「だる」
dialogues.en: "Whew."
dialogues.text: "Whew."

dialogues.jp:
読み慣れない本と、使い慣れない包丁を両手に
構え、外見はあまり美味しそうではないのだが、
匂いだけはカレーのものだった。
dialogues.en:
Holding a book that I don't usually read in one hand, and an
unfamiliar knife in my other hand, I cook a curry. It smells
good, but doesn't look good.
dialogues.text:
Holding a book that I don't usually read in one hand, and an
unfamiliar knife in my other hand, I cook a curry. It smells
good, but doesn't look good.

dialogues.jp:
「休みになると３食きっかりと準備せにゃなら
　んのが面倒だな……」
dialogues.en:
"It's a pain in the neck that I have to cook three meals a
day during the break."
dialogues.text:
"It's a pain in the neck that I have to cook three meals a
day during the break."

dialogues.jp:
肩を落としながらも、鍋をかきまぜるのは止め
ない。
dialogues.en: I keep stirring the pot as I drop my shoulders.
dialogues.text: I keep stirring the pot as I drop my shoulders.

dialogues.jp:
とりあえず、このカレーさえ作ってしまえば、
いついかなるときでも飢えに耐えることが出来
るのだ。
dialogues.en: As long as I have this curry sauce, I can endure the hunger.
dialogues.text: As long as I have this curry sauce, I can endure the hunger.

dialogues.jp: 「しかも、寝かせればさらに美味しくなる」
dialogues.en: "Besides, it will taste even better if it's aged."
dialogues.text: "Besides, it will taste even better if it's aged."

dialogues.jp:
一石二鳥くらいでないと、面倒でこんなもの作
れないしな。
dialogues.en:
Kill two birds with one stone, otherwise it's too much
trouble to make curry.
dialogues.text:
Kill two birds with one stone, otherwise it's too much
trouble to make curry.

dialogues.jp: リリン――
dialogues.en: Ting-a-ling!
dialogues.text: Ting-a-ling!

dialogues.jp: と、鈴の音。
dialogues.en: The sound of the bell.
dialogues.text: The sound of the bell.

dialogues.jp: 「音夢のやつが帰ってきたか」
dialogues.en: "I think Nemu's home."
dialogues.text: "I think Nemu's home."

dialogues.jp: 委員会の仕事で夜になるとは言っていたが。
dialogues.en:
She said she would be home late because of the committee
work.
dialogues.text:
She said she would be home late because of the committee
work.

dialogues.jp: なんとなく緊張する。
dialogues.en: I feel a little bit nervous.
dialogues.text: I feel a little bit nervous.

dialogues.jp:
今回の料理に関しては、昨日から機嫌を損ねて
いる音夢へのご機嫌取りも含んでいるのだ。
dialogues.en:
I made this not just for myself, but also to get her in a
better mood. She's been in a bad mood since the day before
yesterday.
dialogues.text:
I made this not just for myself, but also to get her in a
better mood. She's been in a bad mood since the day before
yesterday.

dialogues.jp: ガチャ――。
dialogues.en: Click!
dialogues.text: Click!

dialogues.jp: 「お帰り〜」
dialogues.en: "Hi!"
dialogues.text: "Hi!"

dialogues.jp: なんとなく新婚気分で振り向く。
dialogues.en: I turn around as if I were a newlywed.
dialogues.text: I turn around as if I were a newlywed.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ただいま〜♪」
dialogues.en: "I'm home!"
dialogues.text: "I'm home!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うわぁ、いい匂い……辛いカレー？」
dialogues.en: "Oh my God! Smells so good, is this curry?"
dialogues.text: "Oh my God! Smells so good, is this curry?"

dialogues.jp:
頭上の猫をソファーに座らせて、さくらが近寄っ
てくる。
dialogues.en: Putting her cat down on the couch, Sakura walks over to me.
dialogues.text: Putting her cat down on the couch, Sakura walks over to me.

dialogues.jp: 「お前、どこから入ってきた？」
dialogues.en: "How did you get inside?"
dialogues.text: "How did you get inside?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ん。玄関だよ。もう不法侵入じゃないね♪」
dialogues.en: "I came in the front door. I didn't break in."
dialogues.text: "I came in the front door. I didn't break in."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「呼び鈴を鳴らせ……」
dialogues.en: "You should ring the doorbell."
dialogues.text: "You should ring the doorbell."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「うにゃ〜、お隣さんが勝手に入ってきても問
　題ないのが日本の開けた文化なんだよ？」
dialogues.en:
"Hmm... You should know Japanese culture is very open to
your neighbors. You let them come inside the house without
knocking."
dialogues.text:
"Hmm... You should know Japanese culture is very open to
your neighbors. You let them come inside the house without
knocking."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「そういうのは、携帯電話の通じないような田
　舎でやってくれ」
dialogues.en:
"That must be only in the countryside where there are no
cell phones."
dialogues.text:
"That must be only in the countryside where there are no
cell phones."

dialogues.jp: コンロの火を止めてため息をつく。
dialogues.en: I give a sigh while turning off the stove.
dialogues.text: I give a sigh while turning off the stove.

dialogues.jp: 「あ〜、まぁ、食べたきゃ構わないがな」
dialogues.en: "Well, if you wanna eat, I don't mind."
dialogues.text: "Well, if you wanna eat, I don't mind."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ホント？　やったぁ、じゃあ頂きます」
dialogues.en: "Really? Yippee, thanks!"
dialogues.text: "Really? Yippee, thanks!"

dialogues.jp: そう言いながら、さくらはソファーに戻る。
dialogues.en: Sakura sits down on the couch as she speaks.
dialogues.text: Sakura sits down on the couch as she speaks.

dialogues.jp: 「食べないのか？」
dialogues.en: "Aren't you gonna eat?"
dialogues.text: "Aren't you gonna eat?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「お兄ちゃんと音夢ちゃんと一緒でいいの。ま
　だ食べないでしょ？」
dialogues.en:
"I wanna eat with you and Nemu-chan. You're not eating now,
are you?"
dialogues.text:
"I wanna eat with you and Nemu-chan. You're not eating now,
are you?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「あぁ」
dialogues.en: "Nope."
dialogues.text: "Nope."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「じゃあ、待ってるよ」
dialogues.en: "Then, I will wait."
dialogues.text: "Then, I will wait."

dialogues.jp:
猫の頭をやさしくなでながら、さくらはカレー
のことなどどうでも良いように呟く。
dialogues.en:
Stroking the cat's head, Sakura mumbles as if she's lost
interest in curry.
dialogues.text:
Stroking the cat's head, Sakura mumbles as if she's lost
interest in curry.

dialogues.jp: 「変な奴」
dialogues.en: "Weird."
dialogues.text: "Weird."

dialogues.jp: 手を洗って俺も居間に戻る。
dialogues.en: I go back to the living room after washing my hands.
dialogues.text: I go back to the living room after washing my hands.

dialogues.jp:
さくらの隣のソファーに座って、何気なくテレ
ビをつけた。
dialogues.en:
I casually turn on the TV and sit next to Sakura on the
couch.
dialogues.text:
I casually turn on the TV and sit next to Sakura on the
couch.

dialogues.jp: 「なにか見たい番組ある？」
dialogues.en: "Is there anything you want to watch now?"
dialogues.text: "Is there anything you want to watch now?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「うんん。ボク、テレビは見ないから。そもそ
　も家にないし」
dialogues.en:
"No, I don't usually watch TV. Actually I don't have one at
home."
dialogues.text:
"No, I don't usually watch TV. Actually I don't have one at
home."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「そうか……」
dialogues.en: "Really..."
dialogues.text: "Really..."

dialogues.jp:
テレビがないとはまた、時代錯誤だな。今じゃ
一家に人数分あるようなモノなのに。
dialogues.en: It's way behind the times if you live without a TV.
dialogues.text: It's way behind the times if you live without a TV.

dialogues.jp:
「ん、時代劇とかはまだ見てるんじゃないの
　か？」
dialogues.en: "You must still watch samurai movies, right?"
dialogues.text: "You must still watch samurai movies, right?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ＤＶＤで出てるからパソコンで見てるよ」
dialogues.en: "I sometimes watch DVDs on my computer."
dialogues.text: "I sometimes watch DVDs on my computer."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "Huhh..."
dialogues.text: "Huhh..."

dialogues.jp: なんとも日常会話が続かないやつだ。
dialogues.en: It's very hard to have an ordinary conversation with her.
dialogues.text: It's very hard to have an ordinary conversation with her.

dialogues.jp:
適当なニュース番組で固定して、だらっとソ
ファーにもたれかかる。
dialogues.en: I turn on the news, lean back on the couch and relax.
dialogues.text: I turn on the news, lean back on the couch and relax.

dialogues.speaker: Utamaru
dialogues.jp: 「にゃ〜」
dialogues.en: "Meow!"
dialogues.text: "Meow!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「あははははは」
dialogues.en: "Hahahaha..."
dialogues.text: "Hahahaha..."

dialogues.jp:
なにが楽しいのか、表情の読めない猫の顔を見
つめてさくらがバカ笑いしている。
dialogues.en:
I don't know why it's so funny, but Sakura gives a huge
laugh looking at the cat's face. I can't read its
expression.
dialogues.text:
I don't know why it's so funny, but Sakura gives a huge
laugh looking at the cat's face. I can't read its
expression.

dialogues.jp: 本気で意味が分からない。
dialogues.en: I have absolutely no idea.
dialogues.text: I have absolutely no idea.

dialogues.jp: 「音夢が帰ってくるまで話でもするか」
dialogues.en: "Let's talk until Nemu comes home."
dialogues.text: "Let's talk until Nemu comes home."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「え？　いつもしてるじゃん」
dialogues.en: "What? I thought we always do."
dialogues.text: "What? I thought we always do."

dialogues.jp: 猫の頭をなでながらさくらが首をかしげる。
dialogues.en: Sakura cocks her head at me while stroking the cat's head.
dialogues.text: Sakura cocks her head at me while stroking the cat's head.

dialogues.jp: 「いや、なんとなく、なんだろう」
dialogues.en: "It's been a casual talk, though."
dialogues.text: "It's been a casual talk, though."

dialogues.jp:
なんで俺は話をしようなんて言い出したのだろ
う。
dialogues.en: I don't know why I brought this up.
dialogues.text: I don't know why I brought this up.

dialogues.jp:
普通の話題なら、前置きなんてなくなにげなく
始めればいいのに。
dialogues.en: I should've started to talk without saying anything.
dialogues.text: I should've started to talk without saying anything.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「なんでもいいけどね。お兄ちゃんとお話〜♪」
dialogues.en: "Whatever it is, I love talking with you."
dialogues.text: "Whatever it is, I love talking with you."

dialogues.jp:
当たり前だが、さくらまで身構えるというか、
真面目に話を聞く雰囲気を作ってしまう。
dialogues.en:
Even Sakura psyches herself up, I made a serious atmosphere
for our conversation.
dialogues.text:
Even Sakura psyches herself up, I made a serious atmosphere
for our conversation.

dialogues.jp: 「うん」
dialogues.en: "Yeah."
dialogues.text: "Yeah."

dialogues.jp: もちろん話なんて特にはない。
dialogues.en: Of course, I don't have a special topic.
dialogues.text: Of course, I don't have a special topic.

dialogues.jp: なんでもない話ならいくらでもあるのだが――。
dialogues.en: I have many trivial topics, but...
dialogues.text: I have many trivial topics, but...

dialogues.jp: 「あぁ、お前のことだ」
dialogues.en: "Yeah, let's talk about you."
dialogues.text: "Yeah, let's talk about you."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「いや、俺、そういえばお前のこと全然知らな
　いや」
dialogues.en: "I mean, I don't know very much about you."
dialogues.text: "I mean, I don't know very much about you."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うにゃ？　お医者さんごっこした仲だよ」
dialogues.en: "Hmm? We even played doctors years ago."
dialogues.text: "Hmm? We even played doctors years ago."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「その話題を他の人間の前でしたら殺すぞ……」
dialogues.en: "I will kill you if you disclose that in public."
dialogues.text: "I will kill you if you disclose that in public."

dialogues.jp:
お隣さんうんぬんとかテレビの話をしていたが
よく考えれば、さくらのことを俺はほとんど知
らない。
dialogues.en:
We usually talk about things like the neighbors or a TV
drama, but when I think about it, I realize I don't know her
very well.
dialogues.text:
We usually talk about things like the neighbors or a TV
drama, but when I think about it, I realize I don't know her
very well.

dialogues.jp:
６年前に別れたままの姿なので気になりづらい
が、こいつだって６年間分の想い出があるのだ。
dialogues.en:
I care about what happened after we separated six years ago,
but I'm sure she has her own memories from over there that I
don't know.
dialogues.text:
I care about what happened after we separated six years ago,
but I'm sure she has her own memories from over there that I
don't know.

dialogues.jp: 猫をどこから連れてきたのか。
dialogues.en: Where did she get the cat?
dialogues.text: Where did she get the cat?

dialogues.jp: 向こうに残してきた友達はいないのか。
dialogues.en:
She must have had some friends she had to say good-bye to
over there.
dialogues.text:
She must have had some friends she had to say good-bye to
over there.

dialogues.jp: 色々と知らないことがある。
dialogues.en: I have many things that I don't know about her.
dialogues.text: I have many things that I don't know about her.

dialogues.jp: どうして一人暮らしなのか。
dialogues.en: Why does she live alone?
dialogues.text: Why does she live alone?

dialogues.jp: どんな暮らしをしているのか。
dialogues.en: What kind of lifestyle does she have?
dialogues.text: What kind of lifestyle does she have?

dialogues.jp: どうして帰ってきたのか……。
dialogues.en: Why did she come back to Japan?
dialogues.text: Why did she come back to Japan?

dialogues.jp:
「そうだお前、どうしてこんな時期に帰ってき
　たんだ？」
dialogues.en: "Oh yeah, why did you come back now?"
dialogues.text: "Oh yeah, why did you come back now?"

dialogues.jp:
一番最初に聞かなければならない質問を、すっ
かり忘れていた。
dialogues.en: I realize I should have asked this question first.
dialogues.text: I realize I should have asked this question first.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ん、お兄ちゃんに会いに」
dialogues.en: "Hm, to see you."
dialogues.text: "Hm, to see you."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「いや、だってさ、俺に会いに来るのにわざわ
　ざ転校してくる必要はないだろう」
dialogues.en:
"Um, I don't see any reason to change school from all the
way over there just to see me."
dialogues.text:
"Um, I don't see any reason to change school from all the
way over there just to see me."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「あるよ。だってお兄ちゃんと同じ生活をす
　るには、同じ学園に入らなきゃいけないで
　しょ？」
dialogues.en:
"Well, there is a reason. If I'm going to share my life with
you, I have to go to the same school you attend."
dialogues.text:
"Well, there is a reason. If I'm going to share my life with
you, I have to go to the same school you attend."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「無関係者じゃ学園の敷地に入れないし」
dialogues.en: "If I don't attend this school, I can't even be on campus."
dialogues.text: "If I don't attend this school, I can't even be on campus."

dialogues.jp:
呆れた。こいつ、たったそれだけのために風見
学園に転入してきたのか。
dialogues.en:
It's amazing. She transferred to this school just because of
that.
dialogues.text:
It's amazing. She transferred to this school just because of
that.

dialogues.jp: 「でも時期は？　普通は４月からだろう？」
dialogues.en: "But why now? The new semester starts in April, right?"
dialogues.text: "But why now? The new semester starts in April, right?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「なにがいけないの？　向こうだとこんなの普
　通だよ」
dialogues.en:
"What's wrong with that? It's not unusual to do this kind of
thing over there."
dialogues.text:
"What's wrong with that? It's not unusual to do this kind of
thing over there."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「なにが……」
dialogues.en: "What do you mean?"
dialogues.text: "What do you mean?"

dialogues.jp: 物凄く純粋な返答だった。
dialogues.en: It was an innocent question.
dialogues.text: It was an innocent question.

dialogues.jp: 別に４月でなくても確かに問題はない。
dialogues.en:
It's true, there is no rule that you can only be transferred
to a new school in April.
dialogues.text:
It's true, there is no rule that you can only be transferred
to a new school in April.

dialogues.jp: 「なるほど」
dialogues.en: "I see."
dialogues.text: "I see."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ボクのこと知りたいの？」
dialogues.en: "Do you want to know about me?"
dialogues.text: "Do you want to know about me?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うぇ？」
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.jp: 唐突に、ニヤニヤとさくらが笑う。
dialogues.en: Sakura smiles out of the blue.
dialogues.text: Sakura smiles out of the blue.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「もっと色々と知りたいの？」
dialogues.en: "Do you want to know more?"
dialogues.text: "Do you want to know more?"

dialogues.jp: 俺の顔を覗き込むように呟く。
dialogues.en: She says, looking into my eyes.
dialogues.text: She says, looking into my eyes.

dialogues.en: "Not really..."
dialogues.text: "Not really..."

dialogues.jp:
なんとなく身をひきつつ、なにかが引っかかっ
て仕方が無かった。
dialogues.en: Withdrawing myself, I can't help noticing a vague feeling.
dialogues.text: Withdrawing myself, I can't help noticing a vague feeling.

dialogues.jp: 芳乃さくら。
dialogues.en: Sakura Yoshino.
dialogues.text: Sakura Yoshino.

dialogues.jp: その存在がおかしい。
dialogues.en: It sounds weird.
dialogues.text: It sounds weird.

dialogues.jp: 本人であることに疑問は抱いていないが。
dialogues.en: I know that's her.
dialogues.text: I know that's her.

dialogues.jp: が――あくまで、なにかが引っかかっている。
dialogues.en: However, I feel something isn't right.
dialogues.text: However, I feel something isn't right.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「えへへへ。良いこと考えた」
dialogues.en: "Teehee. I have a good idea."
dialogues.text: "Teehee. I have a good idea."

dialogues.jp: 俺は悪い予感しかしない。
dialogues.en: I have a bad feeling.
dialogues.text: I have a bad feeling.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ただいま〜」
dialogues.en: "I'm home!"
dialogues.text: "I'm home!"

dialogues.jp:
玄関が開く音がして、聞きなれた声が家にこだ
まする。
dialogues.en:
The familiar voice echoes through the house after the door
opens.
dialogues.text:
The familiar voice echoes through the house after the door
opens.

dialogues.jp: 「おかえり」
dialogues.en: "Hi."
dialogues.text: "Hi."

dialogues.jp:
廊下に声をかけると、音夢がいそいそと居間に
入ってくる。
dialogues.en:
When I greet her in the hallway, Nemu hurries into the
living room.
dialogues.text:
When I greet her in the hallway, Nemu hurries into the
living room.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ただいま」
dialogues.en: "Hi there."
dialogues.text: "Hi there."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「あ……さくらちゃんこんばんは」
dialogues.en: "Oh, Sakura-chan, how are you?"
dialogues.text: "Oh, Sakura-chan, how are you?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「お晩です♪」
dialogues.en: "I'm good, thanks."
dialogues.text: "I'm good, thanks."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「うん。あの、兄さんカレー作ったの？」
dialogues.en: "Hm, did you make curry, niisan?"
dialogues.text: "Hm, did you make curry, niisan?"

dialogues.jp: 匂いで気づいたのだろう。
dialogues.en: She must've smelled it.
dialogues.text: She must've smelled it.

dialogues.jp:
「あぁ。さくらも食べてくってさ。量だけは作っ
　たから問題ない」
dialogues.en:
"Yeah. Sakura wants to eat, too. Thank God I made enough for
everybody."
dialogues.text:
"Yeah. Sakura wants to eat, too. Thank God I made enough for
everybody."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「そうなんだ」
dialogues.en: "I see."
dialogues.text: "I see."

dialogues.jp: なぜか音夢の声が寂しく聞こえる。
dialogues.en: Somehow, Nemu sounds sad.
dialogues.text: Somehow, Nemu sounds sad.

dialogues.jp: 「お前、体調でも悪いのか？」
dialogues.en: "Are you feeling okay?"
dialogues.text: "Are you feeling okay?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「う、うんん。そうじゃないの。ちょっと疲れ
　てるんだと思う」
dialogues.en: "Yeah, I think I'm a little tired."
dialogues.text: "Yeah, I think I'm a little tired."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「無理しちゃダメだよ」
dialogues.en: "Don't work too hard!"
dialogues.text: "Don't work too hard!"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「うん」
dialogues.en: "I know."
dialogues.text: "I know."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「俺の台詞……」
dialogues.en: "That's my line..."
dialogues.text: "That's my line..."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「こういうのは誰が言ってもいいの」
dialogues.en: "Anybody can say that."
dialogues.text: "Anybody can say that."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「そうだけどな。じゃ、かったるいが飯にする
　か。用意しておくから着替えてこいよ音夢」
dialogues.en:
"I know. Well, let's eat. I'll set the table, so why don't
you get changed, Nemu?"
dialogues.text:
"I know. Well, let's eat. I'll set the table, so why don't
you get changed, Nemu?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「うん」
dialogues.en: "Yeah."
dialogues.text: "Yeah."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「あ、ちょっと待って音夢ちゃん」
dialogues.en: "Hold on, Nemu-chan."
dialogues.text: "Hold on, Nemu-chan."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "Huh?"
dialogues.text: "Huh?"

dialogues.jp: 呼び止められ、音夢が入り口で立ち尽くす。
dialogues.en: Nemu stops in the doorway when Sakura calls her.
dialogues.text: Nemu stops in the doorway when Sakura calls her.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「ねぇ、お兄ちゃん、何日かボクの家にお泊り
　してもらってもいいかな？」
dialogues.en:
"Listen, is it okay if oniichan sleeps over at my place for
few days?"
dialogues.text:
"Listen, is it okay if oniichan sleeps over at my place for
few days?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「なに？」
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.jp: 俺まで初耳の話題が急に降ってでる。
dialogues.en: That was news to me, too.
dialogues.text: That was news to me, too.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「積もる話もあるし、音夢ちゃんもなんだか疲
　れてるみたいだから、たまには一人になって
　みるのもいいと思うよ」
dialogues.en:
"We have a lot of catching up to do, plus you look so tired,
and it might be good to be alone for a change."
dialogues.text:
"We have a lot of catching up to do, plus you look so tired,
and it might be good to be alone for a change."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「それにお泊りは休みの恒例行事だ――」
dialogues.en:
"Besides, a sleepover is kind of a tradition during a
break."
dialogues.text:
"Besides, a sleepover is kind of a tradition during a
break."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ダメッ！！」
dialogues.en: "No way!!"
dialogues.text: "No way!!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うにょ？」
dialogues.en: "Hmm?"
dialogues.text: "Hmm?"

dialogues.jp: 部屋が急に静かになる。
dialogues.en: The room quiets down all of a sudden.
dialogues.text: The room quiets down all of a sudden.

dialogues.speaker: Utamaru
dialogues.jp: 「にゃ？」
dialogues.en: "Meow?"
dialogues.text: "Meow?"

dialogues.speaker: Utamaru
dialogues.jp: 「なに叫んでんだ音夢？」
dialogues.en: "What are you yelling for, Nemu?"
dialogues.text: "What are you yelling for, Nemu?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「え、あ、その……」

自分の発言を覚えていないかのように、音夢が
あたふたと手を動かす。
dialogues.en: Nemu acts flustered as if she can't remember what she said.
dialogues.text: Nemu acts flustered as if she can't remember what she said.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「ね。音夢ちゃんも友達の家に遊びに行けばい
　いんだよ」
dialogues.en: "Hey, why don't you visit a friend, Nemu-chan?"
dialogues.text: "Hey, why don't you visit a friend, Nemu-chan?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「おい、そもそも俺がいいなんて言ってない
　ぞ？」
dialogues.en: "Hey, I never said I was okay with your plan."
dialogues.text: "Hey, I never said I was okay with your plan."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「いけないの？」
dialogues.en: "Won't you come?"
dialogues.text: "Won't you come?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "Well..."
dialogues.text: "Well..."

dialogues.jp: 反対する理由は……かったるい以外にない。
dialogues.en:
I have reason to refuse the idea except that it's a pain in
the ass.
dialogues.text:
I have reason to refuse the idea except that it's a pain in
the ass.

dialogues.jp:
むしろ、久しぶりにばあちゃんの家に行けると
考えると、なかなか楽しそうでもある。
dialogues.en:
However, if I think of it as visiting grandma, then it could
be fun.
dialogues.text:
However, if I think of it as visiting grandma, then it could
be fun.

dialogues.jp: けれど、音夢がここまで反対するのだ。
dialogues.en: But Nemu sure doesn't like the idea at all.
dialogues.text: But Nemu sure doesn't like the idea at all.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「いいよ」
dialogues.en: "Go ahead."
dialogues.text: "Go ahead."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.jp: あっさりと音夢が意見を｛ひるがえ／翻｝す。
dialogues.en: Nemu changed her mind quickly.
dialogues.text: Nemu changed her mind quickly.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「明日から私、美春か誰かの家に遊びに行くか
　ら」
dialogues.en: "I'll go to Miharu or somebody's house from tomorrow."
dialogues.text: "I'll go to Miharu or somebody's house from tomorrow."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「いや、しかし……そんないきなりだろう？」
dialogues.en: "Come on, it wasn't your plan, was it?"
dialogues.text: "Come on, it wasn't your plan, was it?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「大丈夫。ダメなら家にいるから。どうせ隣の
　家じゃない」
dialogues.en:
"It's okay. If they are busy, I'll stay home. Anyway, you'll
only be next door."
dialogues.text:
"It's okay. If they are busy, I'll stay home. Anyway, you'll
only be next door."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「お前に何かあったときに困るだろう？」
dialogues.en: "What are you gonna do if something happens to you?"
dialogues.text: "What are you gonna do if something happens to you?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「もぅ、私子供じゃないんですよ？　兄さんの
　妹離れのためにも是非実行しましょう」
dialogues.en:
"I'm not a little kid anymore. Let's do it for the sake of
your independence from your sister's influence."
dialogues.text:
"I'm not a little kid anymore. Let's do it for the sake of
your independence from your sister's influence."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「あはははは、プラン決定！　お祝いにカレー
　を食べよ〜」
dialogues.en:
"Hahahaha, okay, then it's decided! Let's eat curried rice
to celebrate!"
dialogues.text:
"Hahahaha, okay, then it's decided! Let's eat curried rice
to celebrate!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「嘘だろ……」
dialogues.en: "You're kidding me..."
dialogues.text: "You're kidding me..."

dialogues.jp:
思わず頭を抱えたくなるが、もちろん反論が見
つからない以上どうしようもない。
dialogues.en:
I don't think it's a good idea, but there's no
counterargument, so I have nothing I can do but to give in.
dialogues.text:
I don't think it's a good idea, but there's no
counterargument, so I have nothing I can do but to give in.

dialogues.jp:
好調であろう音夢の体調を理由にすることだけ
は、したくないし……。
dialogues.en:
It doesn't make sense to use Nemu's health as an excuse. She
seems to be healthy.
dialogues.text:
It doesn't make sense to use Nemu's health as an excuse. She
seems to be healthy.

dialogues.jp: 「勝手にしてくれ」
dialogues.en: "Suit yourself."
dialogues.text: "Suit yourself."

dialogues.jp:
ソファーにぐったりと座り込んで、俺は柳のよ
うに手を揺らした。
dialogues.en:
I swing my hands like a willow tree and sit down on the
couch.
dialogues.text:
I swing my hands like a willow tree and sit down on the
couch.

dialogues.jp: ◆さくらｖｓ音夢◆
dialogues.en: ◆Sakura vs. Nemu◆
dialogues.text: ◆Sakura vs. Nemu◆

dialogues.jp:
昼ご飯時にやってきたさくらと話をする。俺に
会うために帰ってきたと言う言葉に、思わず照
れてしまったりなんだり。
dialogues.en:
Sakura comes over at lunchtime, and we have a casual
conversation. However, I was embarrassed to hear that she
was transferred to my school to see me.
dialogues.text:
Sakura comes over at lunchtime, and we have a casual
conversation. However, I was embarrassed to hear that she
was transferred to my school to see me.

dialogues.jp:
そして、帰宅してきた音夢と３人で話をしてい
るうちに、なぜか俺のさくらの家へのお泊りが
決まってしまった。
dialogues.en:
Nemu came home, and while the three of us were talking, they
made a plan for me to sleep over at Sakura's house before I
knew it.
dialogues.text:
Nemu came home, and while the three of us were talking, they
made a plan for me to sleep over at Sakura's house before I
knew it.

dialogues.jp: 明らかに、さくらが音夢を挑発する形で……。
dialogues.en:
It obviously happened because of Sakura's provocative action
toward Nemu...
dialogues.text:
It obviously happened because of Sakura's provocative action
toward Nemu...
